diagnostics.message: google_project_iam_member.additive grants (possibly service-related) roles on the project but has no ordering dependency on google_project_service.project_services, while the equivalent authoritative binding (google_project_iam_binding.authoritative) explicitly depends on it. If APIs are still being enabled asynchronously when the additive member bindings are applied, the IAM changes can fail or race with API activation. Add 'depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]' (mirroring the authoritative resource).

google_project_iam_member.additive can reference custom roles (var.iam_additive_roles may contain IDs of roles created by google_project_iam_custom_role.roles), but it has no dependency on that resource, unlike google_project_iam_binding.authoritative which explicitly depends on it. A member binding to a custom role that has not been created yet will fail. Add 'depends_on = [google_project_iam_custom_role.roles]'.
